_about: Our own SocSci210-like base dataset (stage 1) and where every SocSci210 study goes, rich 23 Nov 2026. set: Base = stage 1 (not UK-compatible, rebuilt by us from the original materials); UK = stage 2 (UK-compatible, our clean build); Eval = SocSci210's 40 held-out studies, never trained on; Review = UK fit not decided. New non-UK studies join Base; new UK-compatible studies go to the UK set. Generated page: scripts/base_set.py. build_order (24 Nov 2026, rich: rank by value for simulating behaviour and maximise topic diversity): within Eval and within Base separately, greedy pick of the highest Jev 'value' study least similar (local bge-base embedding of its SocSci210 conditions and outcomes) to everything already picked, Base seeded with Eval, no domain over ~25% of picks. Jev value bunched near 3 of 5, so diversity drives most of the order. Materials scan 24 Nov 2026: every SocSci210 OSF deposit opened (nested zips included) and checked for a fielded questionnaire and a data file; status To build when both were found, Materials needed otherwise. UK-set rows were not scanned and stay To map.
